Q51. Which of the following statements are correct?
(A) Chlorobenzene is much less reactive than chloroethane towards nucleophilic substitution by aqueous

(C) 2-Bromobutane, on heating with alcoholic KOH, gives but-2-ene as the major product.
(D) Ethyl fluoride can be prepared by heating ethyl chloride with NaF in dry acetone.
(E) For a given alkyl group, the boiling points of the halides follow the order R−I > R−Br > R−Cl >
R−F.

(2) (A), (C) and (E) only
(3) (A), (B), (C) and (E) only
(4) (C) and (E) only
